question_text: Was the AFP news agency hit by a cyberattack?
answer_text: Yes, by AFP's own account. The news agency says an intruder attacked AFP Forum, the platform its clients use to download its stories, photos and videos, early on Nov 26. It took the platform offline and does not yet know who was behind it.
label: Confirmed

question_text: Who was behind the AFP cyberattack?
what_would_settle_it: AFP, French investigators or another official source naming who carried out the attack, or credible outlets reporting a claim by a group.
AFP saying the platform is back in service, or its front page no longer showing the maintenance notice.

question_text: Was any data taken in the AFP cyberattack?
what_would_settle_it: AFP saying whether any data about its clients or anything else was accessed or taken.

question_text: Did the cyberattack stop AFP's news service?
answer_text: AFP says the target was AFP Forum, one of the platforms clients use to get its content, and that it is offering subscribers other ways to receive it while the platform is down. It has not said that any other system was hit.
label: Confirmed
